title: Plan & billing
subtitle: Manage your library's subscription.
freeMode.title: Everything's included
freeMode.body: Libriant is free for all libraries right now — every feature, with no limits and no subscription needed. We'll give you plenty of notice before any paid plans begin.
manualNotice: Your library is billed manually — contact us to switch invoicing or change plans.
cancelScheduled: Scheduled to cancel on {date}. You can resume any time before then.
errors.paymentFailed: Your last payment didn't go through. Please update your payment details to keep your access.
chooser.title: Choose your plan
chooser.subtitle: To continue using {library}, pick the plan that fits your library. You can change it later in Plan & billing.
chooser.paidHint: Paid plans take you to secure checkout to add a payment method.
chooser.empty: No plans are available right now. Please contact us so we can set you up.
retry.title: Payment retry needed
retry.body: Your last invoice didn't go through. Your plan stays active until {date} — please update your card from the
unreachable: We couldn't reach the billing service. Try refreshing — if it keeps happening, get in touch.
noPlans: No plans are configured yet. Ask an admin to seed the plan catalog.
choosePlanGate: Your library needs to choose a plan before you can continue. Please ask a library admin to set one up.
